title: Raman detection limits
question: How long does a spectrometer have to measure before a model reliably tells a real Raman signal from noise?
description: Synthetic Raman spectra of carbon nanotubes with Poisson and read-out noise. A baseline without machine learning, logistic regression, a random forest and a 1D CNN are compared by the signal-to-noise ratio at which each finds half of the signals. Since that ratio grows with the square root of the exposure time, it sets a minimum measurement time.
